<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/create_workflow/{project_guid}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Creates a new workflow on the project's hub, registers it in the
project's config, and schedules the git commits and runtime reload for
it as background tasks.

The Grid Default project (PROJgridDefault) needn't exist yet: its first
workflow creates it, under the same lock and in the same commit.
